The squad in numbers

  • 17players
  • 10nationalities

  • 200 cmaverage height

The tallest is Nikola Milutinov at 212 cm. The youngest is Nikolaos Plotas (born 2004) and the most experienced Bryant Dunston (born 1986). Beyond Greece, the squad draws most on USA (4), Armenia (1) and Azerbaijan (1). Alexandros Vezenkov, Bryant Dunston, George Papas, Kostas Papanikolaou, Nikola Milutinov and Tyler Dorsey are back for another spell at the club.
